value.rationale: Sliding maxima are a canonical streaming and morphology statistic; uncertainty of update frequency depends on the covariance of successive update events, not just an old total-count law. The exact all-width kernel exhibits strictly negative dependence for every shorter overlap lag and a sharply positive endpoint coincidence at full-window separation.
